proposal.inferred_root_cause: PSP degradation on the upi path for upi:ybl at 32% success over 96 attempts
proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:ybl has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and no Razorpay downtime notice covers it. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on upi_intent after 15m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear. This is the last attempt the stop rule permits, so it is spent after the window rather than inside it.
